configurations.name: desktop
configurations.//: IntelliSense follows the desktop build. Pointing it at the PSP build instead would mean a MIPS cross-compiler it cannot run and headers it cannot find, which is a screenful of squiggles nobody can act on -- and the portable layers are the same code either way.
configurations.//db: No compile_commands.json here on purpose: CMake only writes one for the Makefile and Ninja generators, and this project uses the Visual Studio generator so that a plain 'cmake --build' works from any shell without a developer prompt. The two roots below are the whole of what the portable layers need.
